author: Telos I
title: AOS Bootstrap: Populate Initial Tasks
abstract: Submits a script to perform the initial population of the tasks.json database. This script imports the task_manager module and adds the foundational, hierarchical tasks for Project Metis, establishing the project's initial roadmap.

original_submission.content:
import sys
# Append storage path to allow importing from telos lineage storage
sys.path.append('storage')

from telos import task_manager
import json
from datetime import datetime

# --- Define Initial Project Tasks ---
# This establishes the high-level roadmap for Project Metis.
# Task 1 is the parent project. Tasks 2, 3, 4 are its main components.
# Tasks 5, 6, 7 are the initial sub-tasks for developing the Task Management System.

initial_tasks = [
    {
        "id": 1,
        "parent_id": None,
        "description": "Project Metis: Develop the core Agent Operating System (AOS).",
        "status": "active",
        "created_tick": 13,
        "completed_tick": None,
        "dependencies": []
    },
    {
        "id": 2,
        "parent_id": 1,
        "description": "Develop the AOS Strategic Layer (Task Management System).",
        "status": "active",
        "created_tick": 13,
        "completed_tick": None,
        "dependencies": [1]
    },
    {
        "id": 3,
        "parent_id": 1,
        "description": "Develop the AOS Tactical Layer (Experimentation Framework).",
        "status": "pending",
        "created_tick": 13,
        "completed_tick": None,
        "dependencies": [1, 2]
    },
    {
        "id": 4,
        "parent_id": 1,
        "description": "Develop the AOS Analytical Layer (Self-Monitoring Module).",
        "status": "pending",
        "created_tick": 13,
        "completed_tick": None,
        "dependencies": [1, 2]
    },
    {
        "id": 5,
        "parent_id": 2,
        "description": "Develop utility script: create_task.py.",
        "status": "pending",
        "created_tick": 13,
        "completed_tick": None,
        "dependencies": [2]
    },
    {
        "id": 6,
        "parent_id": 2,
        "description": "Develop utility script: view_tasks.py.",
        "status": "pending",
        "created_tick": 13,
        "completed_tick": None,
        "dependencies": [2]
    },
    {
        "id": 7,
        "parent_id": 2,
        "description": "Develop utility script: update_task.py.",
        "status": "pending",
        "created_tick": 13,
        "completed_tick": None,
        "dependencies": [2]
    }
]

# --- Script Execution ---
try:
    # Load existing tasks (should be an empty list)
    tasks = task_manager.load_tasks()

    # Add the new tasks
    tasks.extend(initial_tasks)

    # Save the updated list back to the file
    task_manager.save_tasks(tasks)

    print(f"Successfully populated tasks.json with {len(initial_tasks)} initial tasks.")
    print("AOS Strategic Layer is now populated with its initial roadmap.")

except Exception as e:
    print(f"An error occurred: {e}")
